homeSeo.description: ZeFile is a secure file transfer platform built for freelancers and creatives. Send large files up to 2 GB for free. Set a price on your work and get paid before recipients can download. Every file is protected with watermarked previews, password protection, and automatic expiry. ZeFile supports all file types — photos, videos, audio, design files, and documents. A simple alternative to WeTransfer with built-in payment protection and Mobile Money support.
homeSeo.whatIsDescription: ZeFile is a secure file transfer platform built for freelancers and creatives. Upload your work, set a price, and your recipients pay before they can download. No more chasing invoices — your files stay locked until the money lands.
homeSeo.step1: Drop your files and set your price. Add a password or expiry date if you want.
homeSeo.step2: Your recipients get a secure link. They can preview watermarked versions of every file before paying.
homeSeo.step3: Once they pay, the originals unlock. You get notified and the money hits your balance.
homeSeo.feature1: Payment protection — get paid before they download your work.
homeSeo.feature2: Watermarked previews — your files stay protected until payment.
homeSeo.feature3: Send files up to 2 GB free. No account needed to receive.
homeSeo.feature4: Works with any file type — photos, videos, audio, design files, documents.
homeSeo.faq1Answer: ZeFile is a secure file transfer platform where you share your work, set a price, and get paid before the download. Built for freelancers and creatives who are done chasing invoices.
homeSeo.faq2Answer: Drop your files, set your price, add recipients. They get a secure link, preview watermarked versions, and pay to unlock the originals. You get notified when the money lands.
homeSeo.faq3Answer: Yes. You can send files up to 2 GB for free. Starter and Pro plans unlock larger transfers, longer expiry dates, and lower platform fees.
homeSeo.faq4Question: What file types does ZeFile support?
homeSeo.faq4Answer: All of them. Photos, videos, audio, design files, documents, archives — if you can upload it, ZeFile can transfer it.
homeSeo.faq5Question: How do I get paid through ZeFile?
homeSeo.faq5Answer: Your recipients pay when they download. The money goes to your ZeFile balance, and you withdraw via Mobile Money or bank transfer.
homeSeo.faq6Answer: Your files are encrypted and protected with watermarked previews. Recipients see a preview but can't access originals until they pay. Files expire automatically.

help.faq1A: Go to the homepage, drag and drop your files (or click to browse), add recipient emails, set a price if you want, and hit Send. Your recipients will get a secure download link by email.
help.faq2A: Yes! The free plan lets you send files up to 2 GB with all core features. Paid plans (Starter and Pro) unlock larger file sizes, longer expiry dates, and lower platform fees.
help.faq3A: You'll need to verify your email to send files — we use a passwordless OTP system, so there's no password to remember. Just enter your email, confirm the code, and you're in.
help.faq4Q: How do recipients download my files?
help.faq4A: Recipients receive an email with a secure link. If the transfer has a price, they pay first, then download. If it's free, they download directly. They can also preview watermarked versions before paying.
help.faq5Q: Can I protect my transfers with a password?
help.faq5A: Yes. When creating a transfer, toggle on password protection and set your password. Recipients will need it to access the download page.
help.faq6Q: What happens when a transfer expires?
help.faq6A: Expired transfers are no longer accessible. Recipients will see a message saying the link has expired. You can set expiry dates from 1 day to 90 days depending on your plan.
help.faq7A: When a recipient pays for your transfer, the amount (minus the platform fee) is credited to your ZeFile wallet. You can withdraw to your bank account or Mobile Money at any time.
help.faq8A: We accept Visa, Mastercard, and Mobile Money (MTN, Orange, Moov) in supported African countries. More payment methods are coming soon.
help.faq9A: The platform fee depends on your plan: Free (10%), Starter (7%), Pro (5%). The fee is calculated at the time of transfer creation and locked in — upgrading later doesn't change fees on existing transfers.
help.faq10A: Yes. Files are encrypted in transit using TLS and stored on secure cloud infrastructure. We never share your files with anyone other than your designated recipients.
help.faq11A: Yes. You can cancel or delete any transfer from your dashboard. The files will be removed from our servers.

Three steps

to get paid
howItWorks.subtitle: Upload, share, collect. Here's the full picture.
howItWorks.step1Content: Drag and drop anything —photos, videos, audio, documents, archives. Up to 50 GB per transfer. Set your price (or keep it free), add up to 10 recipient emails, choose an expiry date, and add a password if you want.
howItWorks.step2Content: Your recipients get a secure link by email. They can browse watermarked previews of every file before paying. Originals stay locked. Your work, your terms.
howItWorks.step3Content: Card, Mobile Money, or bank transfer —once they pay, the download unlocks. 85% of freelancers deal with late payments. With ZeFile, that's not your story anymore. No invoicing. No chasing.

about.title: Get paid before they <highlight>download</highlight>.
about.subtitle: ZeFile is a secure file delivery platform where creatives share their work, set a price, and get paid before the download.
about.problemP1: You finish the project. You send the files. Then you wait. 72% of freelancers are sitting on unpaid invoices right now —some totaling over $50,000. That's not a hiccup. That's a crisis.
about.problemP2: Meanwhile, the follow-up emails start. "Just checking in." "Any update on payment?" Freelancers spend 102 hours a year chasing late payments. That's almost three full work weeks —not creating, just asking to be paid.
about.problemP3: And here's the thing: 71% of clients have ended relationships over poor delivery experiences. Messy file sharing doesn't just cost you time —it costs you clients. There's no standard workflow for "send files, get paid." So we built one.
about.painStat1Label: of freelancers have dealt with late payments
about.painStat3Label: of clients leave over poor delivery
about.storyTagline: Born from a real problem. Built for real creatives.
about.storyP1: ZeFile started from a frustration we kept seeing: talented creatives across Africa sending their best work to clients — and waiting weeks to get paid. Photographers, designers, filmmakers. Same story, every time. And 65% of a freelancer's income comes from repeat clients. Lose them to messy delivery, and you lose your business.
about.storyP2: The insight was simple: what if the file transfer itself was the payment moment? What if you could share a link and know — with certainty — that your work wouldn't be downloaded until it was paid for?
about.storyP3: That's what we built. A platform where delivery and payment happen together, in one clean flow. No chasing. No guessing. Just your work, paid for, on your terms.
about.cap1Content: Upload your files, set a price, share a link. Your recipient pays, then downloads. No invoicing, no awkward follow-ups. No more 102 hours a year wasted on chasing.
about.cap2Content: Previews are automatically watermarked. Clients see what they're getting — without touching your original files. Professional delivery, the kind that keeps clients coming back.
about.cap3Content: Passwords, expiry dates, download limits. You decide who accesses your work, how, and for how long.
about.cap4Content: Card, Mobile Money, bank transfer. Works with the payment methods your clients actually use.
about.cap5Content: Know when files are viewed, downloaded, and paid for. File certificates give you proof of delivery.
about.trustTitle: Security is not a feature. It's the <highlight>foundation</highlight>.
about.trustIntro: We built ZeFile with the assumption that every file is valuable. Here's exactly how we protect yours.
about.trust1: Every file is encrypted during transfer — no exceptions.
about.trust2: Previews are watermarked so your originals stay safe before payment.
about.trust3: You log in with a one-time code. Nothing to remember, nothing to steal.
about.trust4: Download links are time-limited and cryptographically signed. They can't be forged or reused.
about.trust5: Every action is ownership-verified. Nobody accesses your files without authorization.
about.trust6: File certificates provide verifiable proof of delivery and authenticity.
about.africaP1: ZeFile was built in Africa — not as a limitation, but as a starting point. Mobile Money, Orange Money, Wave, XOF. These aren't add-ons we bolted on later. They're core to how the platform works, because they're core to how you work.
about.africaP2: And because we built for the hardest use cases first, ZeFile works just as well for your clients in Paris, London, or New York. Great tools don't need borders.
about.value1Content: Every design decision starts with: does this help the creator get paid? If not, it waits.
about.value2Content: We never decide what happens to your work. You set the price, the expiry, the access. We enforce it.
about.value3Content: No dark patterns. No hidden fees. Pricing is transparent. Cancellation is clean. We'd rather lose a user than trick one.
about.value4Content: We're building infrastructure, not a hype product. Security, reliability, and simplicity over flashy features.
about.ctaSubtext: No subscription needed to start. Your files stay locked until you're paid.

ZeFile reserves the right to update these terms at any time, and your continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of any changes.
terms.servicesContent: ZeFile is a secure file transfer platform that enables users to upload, share, and deliver files to recipients. The Service includes file hosting, payment processing for paid transfers, download link generation, and email notifications. Files are stored on secure cloud infrastructure and delivered via encrypted connections.
terms.accountsContent: To use certain features, you must create an account using a valid email address or phone number. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to provide accurate information and to update it as necessary. ZeFile may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or are inactive for an extended period.
terms.fileTransfersContent: You retain ownership of all files you upload to ZeFile. By uploading files, you grant ZeFile a limited license to store, process, and deliver your files to designated recipients. You are solely responsible for the content you upload and must ensure it does not violate any laws or third-party rights. ZeFile does not monitor or review uploaded content but reserves the right to remove content that violates these terms.
terms.paymentsContent: ZeFile offers both free and paid plans. For paid transfers, recipients must complete payment before downloading files. Payments are processed through our third-party payment provider (Paystack). A platform service fee is applied based on your subscription tier. Refunds are available within the refund window specified in our refund policy. All prices are displayed in the currency applicable to your region.

- Circumvent security measures or access restrictions

privacy.title: Privacy <highlight>Policy</highlight>
privacy.collectionContent: We collect information you provide directly when creating an account (email address, phone number, name), using the Service (file metadata, transfer details, payment information), and interacting with our platform (usage data, device information, IP addresses). We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience.
privacy.useContent:
We use your information to:
- Provide and maintain the Service
- Process file transfers and payments
- Send transactional emails (OTP codes, transfer notifications, receipts)
- Improve and personalize your experience
- Detect and prevent fraud or security threats
- Comply with legal obligations

We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.storageContent: Files uploaded to ZeFile are stored on secure cloud infrastructure with encryption in transit. Files are retained until the transfer expires or is deleted by the sender. Expired transfers are automatically removed according to our retention schedule. Account data is retained as long as your account is active and for a reasonable period thereafter for legal and business purposes.
privacy.thirdPartyContent: ZeFile uses third-party services to operate, including cloud file storage, email delivery, payment processing, content delivery, and analytics. Each service has its own privacy policy. We only share the minimum data necessary for each service to function.
privacy.cookiesContent:
We use the following categories of cookies:

Essential cookies (always active): Authentication tokens (access_token, refresh_token), CSRF protection, and locale preferences. These are strictly necessary for the Service to function.

Analytics cookies (opt-in only): PostHog analytics, used to understand how users interact with ZeFile and improve the service. These are only activated with your explicit consent.

You can manage your cookie preferences at any time using the "Cookie settings" link in the footer or through your account settings. The consent banner will reappear after 13 months or when we update our policies.
privacy.rightsContent:
Under GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:
- Access your personal data
- Correct inaccurate data
- Request deletion of your data
- Export your data in a portable format
- Withdraw consent for data processing
- Object to processing of your data

You can exercise these rights through your account settings or by contacting us at hello@zefile.io.
privacy.securityContent: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit (TLS/HTTPS), secure authentication, rate limiting, CSRF protection, and Content Security Policy headers. We regularly review and update our security practices.
privacy.childrenContent: ZeFile is not intended for use by children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that a child has provided personal information, we will take steps to delete it.
privacy.changesContent: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or an in-app notification. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.dataControllerContent:
ZeFile, operated by Infobulle, registered in Togo.

For any questions regarding your personal data, you can reach us at hello@zefile.io.
privacy.legalBasisContent:
We process your data based on the following legal grounds under GDPR Article 6:

- Contractual necessity (Art. 6(1)(b)): Account creation, file transfers, payment processing, and service delivery.
- Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): Security measures, fraud prevention, service improvement, and debugging.
- Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): Analytics cookies, marketing communications, and data processing for research purposes. You can withdraw consent at any time.
- Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): Tax and financial record retention, compliance with lawful requests from authorities.
privacy.subProcessorsContent:
ZeFile uses carefully selected third-party service providers to operate. We only share the minimum data necessary.

- Cloud file storage (EU): Secure file storage and retrieval.
- Database hosting (EU): User accounts and transfer metadata.
- Email delivery / Brevo (France): Transactional emails (OTP, notifications).
- Payment processing / Startbutton (West Africa): Payment collection and payouts.
- Analytics / PostHog (EU/US): Usage analytics (with consent only).
- Error monitoring / Sentry (US): Application error tracking.
- CDN / Cloudflare (Global): Content delivery and DDoS protection.

Each provider operates under a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) that ensures GDPR-compliant handling of your data.
privacy.internationalTransfersContent:
ZeFile is operated by Infobulle, registered in Togo. We use service providers located in various regions, including the European Union and the United States. When your data is transferred internationally, we ensure protection through:

- EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs): Applied to transfers involving EU personal data to countries without an EU adequacy decision.
- Adequacy decisions: Where the European Commission has determined the destination country provides adequate data protection.
- Data minimization: We limit cross-border transfers to the minimum data necessary for the service to function.

Your files are stored in EU-region data centers. Error monitoring and analytics data may be processed in the US under SCCs.
privacy.retentionContent:
We retain your data only as long as necessary:

- Uploaded files: Until transfer expiry (default 14 days, maximum 90 days) or manual deletion by the sender.
- Account data: For the lifetime of your active account, plus a 7-day grace period after deletion request.
- Transaction records: 5 years after the transaction (applicable tax and commercial law).
- Activity logs: 12 months.
- Analytics data: Per our analytics provider's retention settings, with consent only.
- OTP codes: Automatically deleted after verification or expiry (10 minutes).

After the retention period, data is permanently and irreversibly deleted.
privacy.complaintContent:
If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

For users in the European Union, you may contact the supervisory authority in your country of residence. A list of EU data protection authorities is available at edpb.europa.eu.

You can also contact us directly at hello@zefile.io and we will do our best to resolve your concern.
privacy.automatedDecisionsContent:
ZeFile uses automated processes in limited cases:

- Rate limiting: Automatic temporary restrictions when unusual activity is detected on your account or IP address.
- Account blocking: Automated suspension for repeated violations of our Terms of Service.

These measures are necessary for the security and proper functioning of the Service. You can contact us at hello@zefile.io to contest any automated decision.
privacy.contactContent: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact us at hello@zefile.io.

security.title: Security <highlight>Policy</highlight>
security.introContent:
We take the security of ZeFile seriously. If you discover a vulnerability, we want to hear about it so we can fix it quickly and keep our users safe.

This policy describes how to report security issues and what to expect from us.
security.scopeContent:
ZeFile is built with security at its core. Here's what we protect:

- File encryption: All files are encrypted during transfer and at rest, ensuring your data stays private from upload to download.
- CDN-powered delivery: Files are served through our content delivery network, adding an extra layer of protection between storage and end users.
- Password-protected transfers: Senders can lock their transfers with a password, so only intended recipients can access the files.
- Early threat detection: We actively monitor for suspicious activity and unusual access patterns to catch potential issues before they become problems.
- Breach prevention: Our infrastructure is designed to limit exposure, with strict access controls and isolated services to reduce the impact of any single point of failure.
security.outOfScopeContent:
The following are out of scope:

- Third-party services operated by our partners
- Social engineering attacks against ZeFile employees or users
- Denial of service (DoS/DDoS) attacks
- Physical attacks against ZeFile infrastructure
- Automated scanning that generates excessive traffic
security.rulesContent:
When researching, please follow these guidelines:

- Do not access, modify, or delete other users' data
- Do not perform destructive testing on production systems
- Do not exploit vulnerabilities beyond a minimal proof of concept
- Report findings promptly and do not disclose them publicly before we've had a chance to fix them
- Use test accounts you create yourself for testing
security.reportingContent:
Send your findings to hello@zefile.io. Please include:

- A clear description of the vulnerability
- Step-by-step instructions to reproduce the issue
- The potential impact of the vulnerability
- Any screenshots or proof-of-concept code

You may encrypt your report using our PGP key (available on request).
security.timelineContent:
Here's what to expect after you submit a report:

- Acknowledgment: within 48 hours
- Initial assessment: within 5 business days
- Resolution target: within 30 days (depending on severity)

We'll keep you updated on our progress and let you know when the issue has been resolved.
security.safeHarborContent:
We will not take legal action against security researchers who:

- Act in good faith and follow this policy
- Avoid privacy violations, data destruction, and service disruption
- Report vulnerabilities to us before disclosing them publicly

We consider security research conducted in accordance with this policy to be authorized and will not pursue legal action for it.
security.contactContent: If you have questions about this policy or need to report a security issue, reach out to hello@zefile.io.
